_notes: 1) Habakkuk 3: The Vulgate (Breviary) verse numbering differs from 思高/Hebrew — the Vulgate has ~33 verses split more finely; 思高 has 19. Mappings are by content. 2) Hab 3:17 'altitudo manus suas levavit' — 思高 v.10 does not explicitly render 'the height/deep lifted its hands'; translated as '高处举起了双手' following the Vulgate sense since 思高 compresses this portion. 3) Hab 3:27 'ut ascéndam ad pópulum accínctum nostrum' — 思高 v.16 'because that day must come upon the nation attacking us'; rendered faithfully. 4) Hab 3:33 'in psalmis canéntem' — 思高 v.19 ends with 'and on the high places to walk'; '歌唱赞美之曲' added for 'in psalmis canéntem' (in playing psalms/songs) following Vulgate sense. 5) Wisdom 10:17-21: 思高 wording used verbatim; Latin 10:17 splits the verse so the second half (beginning 'Et fuit illis') carries day/night imagery. Latin 10:19 'ab altitudine inferorum edúxit illos' — 思高 v.19 'from the sea-bottom threw them out'; rendered '从深渊的底部抛出' matching sense. 6) 'Ibid. 10:17-21' refers back to Wisdom (智慧篇); rendered as '智 10:17-21'. 7) 'Ibid. v. 13-19' refers back to Habakkuk (哈 3:13-19); rendered as '同上，第13-19节'.
